title: Segment Activation: Cloud Storage Egress at Audience Scale

steps.prompt: Marketing activates a 20-million-profile segment to Amazon S3 every morning for ad platforms. The design must avoid CRM API ceilings and keep egress operationally simple. Which activation pattern fits?

options.label: Data 360 Cloud Storage Activation Target exporting compressed Parquet files directly to S3
options.rationale: Cloud Storage activation targets push bulk compressed datasets (Parquet/CSV) directly to external buckets without touching CRM API limits or consuming transactional worker threads.

options.label: Bulk API 2.0 query job exporting segment member IDs to an intermediate on-premise staging server
options.distractorAntipattern: Querying 20M rows through core CRM APIs creates significant extraction lag and consumes daily API allocations.
options.rationale: Extracting 20 million profiles via CRM Bulk API incurs heavy export processing time, staging infrastructure overhead, and API quota consumption.

options.label: Apex Batch job querying Unified Individual DMOs and streaming records to Amazon S3 via REST
options.distractorAntipattern: Querying DMOs from Apex batch is subject to SOQL limits, callout timeouts, and transaction heap ceilings.
options.rationale: Apex batch jobs cannot stream 20 million profiles to external endpoints without encountering transaction limits, heap errors, and callout timeouts.
